in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_scale[0]
for a0 in 0..8:
    for a1 in 0..8:
        for a2 in 0..1024:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                in1 = load q[0, 8 * a0 + a1, 0, a3]
                in2 = load k[0, a0, a2, a3]
                f32 v0 = multiply(in1, in2)
                acc1 <- add(acc1, v0) over a3
            v1 = multiply(acc1, in0)
            acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v1) over a2
        for a2 in 0..1024:
            for a5 in 0..128:
                in3 = load q[0, 8 * a0 + a1, 0, a5]
                in4 = load k[0, a0, a2, a5]
                f32 v2 = multiply(in3, in4)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v2) over a5
            v3 = multiply(acc3, in0)
            v4 = subtract(v3, acc0)
            v5 = exp(v4)
            acc2 <- add(acc2, v5) over a2
        for a6 in 0..128:
            for a7 in 0..1024:
                for a8 in 0..128:
                    in5 = load q[0, 8 * a0 + a1, 0, a8]
                    in6 = load k[0, a0, a7, a8]
                    f32 v6 = multiply(in5, in6)
                    acc5 <- add(acc5, v6) over a8
                v7 = multiply(acc5, in0)
                v8 = subtract(v7, acc0)
                v9 = exp(v8)
                v10 = divide(v9, acc2)
                in7 = load v[0, a0, a7, a6]
                v11 = multiply(in7, v10)
                acc4 <- add(acc4, v11) over a7
            reshape_3[0, 8 * a0 + a1, 0, a6] = acc4

let v0 = 1.0
in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_scale[0]
for a0 in 0..8:
    for a1 in 0..4:
        for a2 in 0..8:
            for a3 in 0..128:
                for a4 in 0..256 window(parent=a4 in 0..1024, partition=true):
                    for a5 in 0..128:
                        in1 = load q[0, 8 * a0 + a2, 0, a5]
                        in2 = load k[0, a0, 256 * a1 + a4, a5]
                        f32 v1 = multiply(in1, in2)
                        acc3 <- add(acc3, v1) over a5
                    in3 = load v[0, a0, 256 * a1 + a4, a3]
                    v2 = multiply(acc3, in0)
                    v3 = maximum(acc2, v2)
                    v4 = subtract(acc2, v3)
                    v5 = exp(v4)
                    v6 = subtract(v2, v3)
                    v7 = exp(v6)
                    v8 = multiply(acc0, v5)
                    v9 = multiply(v0, v7)
                    acc0 <- add(v8, v9) over a4
                    v10 = multiply(acc1, v5)
                    v11 = multiply(in3, v7)
                    acc1 <- add(v10, v11) over a4
                    acc2 <- maximum(acc2, v2) over a4
                reshape_3__partial[0, a1, a0, a2, a3] = acc2
                reshape_3__partial[1, a1, a0, a2, a3] = acc0
                reshape_3__partial[2, a1, a0, a2, a3] = acc1

for a0 in 0..8:
    for a1 in 0..8:
        for a2 in 0..128:
            for a3 in 0..4 window(parent=a3 in 0..4, partition=true):
                in0 = load reshape_3__partial[0, a3, a0, a1, a2]
                in1 = load reshape_3__partial[1, a3, a0, a1, a2]
                in2 = load reshape_3__partial[2, a3, a0, a1, a2]
                v0 = maximum(acc2, in0)
                v1 = subtract(acc2, v0)
                v2 = exp(v1)
                v3 = subtract(in0, v0)
                v4 = exp(v3)
                v5 = multiply(acc0, v2)
                v6 = multiply(in1, v4)
                acc0 <- add(v5, v6) over a3
                v7 = multiply(acc1, v2)
                v8 = multiply(in2, v4)
                acc1 <- add(v7, v8) over a3
                acc2 <- maximum(acc2, in0) over a3
            v9 = divide(acc1, acc0)
            reshape_3[0, 8 * a0 + a1, 0, a2] = v9
